notes.title: Update 6.3: Hazard elements, clearer tutorial, adjusted EXP curve
notes.content:
Hey all!
This time on Skyseeker, we're bringing to you a few small gameplay changes.
[list]
[*] New hazards are now discoverable throughout the map, such as spike plants and bomb fruits. These hazards will damage both you and your enemies, so use them to your advantage!
[*] Tutorial is now more clear on how to capture Fauna, and how to attack directionally.
[*] Capture ball now shows a timer for how long you have left.
[*] There is now a shortcut from the Valley of Lilles to the Grand Crossroads
[*] Capturing a Fauna no longer reduces its level by 2.
[/list]

A huge thanks to everyone who has been playing the demo during the Steam Festival! We've been getting coverage from some great youtube channels. 

Gym Leader Ed: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bW1Ob0y0WOo&feature=youtu.be]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bW1Ob0y0WOo&feature=youtu.be[/url]
DualShot66: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CbYFq6ao8Ao]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CbYFq6ao8Ao[/url]
Monster Tamer Bloba: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aXI2ucn5qZg]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aXI2ucn5qZg&feature=youtu.be[/url]

A new subreddit was made by the community, check it out at [url=https://reddit.com/r/skyseeker]https://reddit.com/r/skyseeker[/url]

As always, hit the wishlist button to support Skyseeker as we push towards the Early Access release!
Kirisame Jump

notes.title: Skyseeker 6.2: Quick hotfixes
notes.content:
Just a few small fixes, courtesy of Scheuchevogel's reports.
[list]
[*] Capture balls should no longer bug out when a Fauna dies before ball reaches it.
[*] "F to open menu" added to bottom right legend.
[*] You can no longer leave the map through the Explorer Capital tower.
[*] Updated Title Screen graphics
[/list]

notes.title: Skyseeker v6.1 : Steam Festival Update
notes.content:
Hey there!

Skyseeker is a monster-collecting metroidvania where every enemy is catchable. Our aim is to combine the joy of team-building in games like Pokemon, with real-time combat and and a vast explorable map. Every monster you catch has unique skills and movement options, and you'll have to create your own squad for winning battles and getting around the world.

We're excited to unveil Skyseeker v6.1, our latest version of the free open beta. Our team's development on Skyseeker has moved rapidly over the past months, and we're finally ready to show off what we got at the Steam Game Festival!

We designed this free build to contain a sizable portion of the game's content, featuring a total of four playable maps to explore. We've made major improvements to multiple aspects of the game, including:
[list]
[*] Overhauling map design
[*] More events and encounters in the world
[*] Blessing unlock system
[*] Fauna tracking system (Faunadex can be filled out!)
[*] Even more blessings
[*] Even more fauna (up to 40+)
[*] Even more fauna evolutions
[*] Rival and side rival characters
[*] Overall game balance
[*] More music 
[*] New water shaders
[*] Elevators and gondolas 
[*] Improved fauna catching system
[/list] 

Play the build here at [url=https://kvfrans.itch.io/skyseeker]https://kvfrans.itch.io/skyseeker[/url]

As always, don't forget to wishlist if you are interested, it helps us out a lot.
Thank you for following Skyseeker!
